entities.name: Awn Shawkat Al-Khasawneh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Awn Shawkat Al-Khasawneh is a Jordanian former politician and judge who was the 39th Prime Minister of Jordan, serving from October 2011 to April 2012. He was also formerly a judge of the International Court of Justice.
